newsitem.title: USA: T Cell Sciences sets price of offering.
newsitem.headline: T Cell Sciences sets price of offering.

text.p: T Cell Sciences Inc said Tuesday it has set the price of a public offering of five million shares at $2.1875 per share.
After the offering is completed, there will be about 24,946,601 shares outstanding.

The company plans to use the net proceeds to fund ongoing clinical trials and to manufacture clinical supplies for its lead therapeutic product, TP10, research and development of other products, and general corporate purposes.
The offering is being managed by Genesis Merchant Group Securities as exclusive selling agent.
